The '''Republic of Zhensanov''' is a defunct republic named in the source list of defunct nations.

The current 1994-back draft set already includes the [[Union of Zhensanov]], but the source list does not explain whether the republic was a predecessor, constituent polity, rival government, or unrelated state using the same name.

== Canon Limits ==

Do not treat the Republic of Zhensanov as the confirmed predecessor of the Union until stronger source material identifies the succession chain.
